_comment: D-16 FinBERT weights for F9. `revision` is PINNED to a commit sha, not 'main': HuggingFace main moves, and scoring the same headline against two revisions gives two different F9 values, silently breaking G-10 reproducibility. Bump it deliberately; the manifest records the resolved sha for config_hash. flax/tf weights (~400 MB each) are skipped — F9 needs the PyTorch set only.
